description: This is a great fundraiser for our Project Graduation for the class of 2027. All proceeds will go directly to the class. Runners and walkers are all welcome. All participants will receive a commemorative Turkey Trot 2026 medal! You'll need to pick up your bib and race prep items. We'll be hosting bib pickup Admission: $25 adults/ $10 kids 1 mile

title: Dana Warp Mill Holiday Art Walk & Market
description:
The 5th annual Art Walk has become an exciting event in Westbrook, especially as the whole city is decorated in its Christmas lights. This is your moment to explore the historic Dana Warp Mill and cross everyone off your Christmas list while supporting local small businesses and artists!

Free all day parking is available at the City's parking garage located at 7 Vertical Way, plus limited street parking around the mill. And don't forget to grab lunch or dinner at one of our great restaurants in Westbrook. 

The event is organized by Cee and she studios and supported by Discover Downtown Westbrook and Chinburg Properties.

description: Free, family-friendly meet and greet with Santa, with photos at Cowbell and treats for all visitors. Rock Row may refuse parking or entry once capacity is reached. Contact: rockrowevents@waterstonepg.com.
